subject: [PATCH v4 10/21] erofs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations in the erofs file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using macros that wrap the iomap_iter_next() helper. This change does not introduce any functional changes and is a step towards adopting the new iomap API. The conversion affects two files: data.c and zmap.c.
